rooms.room_description: Perfect for colleagues, friends, or small families traveling together, the Double Double Room features two plush double beds in a smartly arranged space. Large windows bring in natural light, while modern amenities and elegant interiors offer flexibility, comfort, and aesthetic harmony for every kind of stay.

Designed for modern business travelers and solo guests, the King Room offers a refined balance of comfort and functionality. Floor-to-ceiling windows welcome natural light, complemented by soft-toned interiors and a thoughtful layout—ideal for relaxing, focusing, or recharging. A plush king-size bed, spacious bathroom with separate shower and bathtub, and well-curated smart amenities ensure a seamless and restful stay.​

An ideal room for guests traveling with colleagues or loved ones. Located on the upper floors, the Executive Double Double Room offers a peaceful, private space with sweeping views of the city. Two comfortable double beds provide flexibility and comfort—perfect for business trips with a companion, or visits to family in the city. Thoughtful design and full modern amenities ensure a smooth and restful stay.​

Located on higher floors for enhanced privacy and panoramic city views, the Executive King Room is designed for solo travelers with refined taste. Soft textures, clean lines, and curated details create an atmosphere of quiet sophistication—perfect for a gentle start to the day or a peaceful end to a busy one.​

Spacious and refined, the Suite offers a distinctly private retreat with a separate living area, a quiet bedroom, and a marble bathroom featuring a deep soaking tub and panoramic city views. Elegantly designed and fully equipped, every detail is crafted for comfort—whether you’re resting, recharging, or enjoying meaningful time with loved ones in a serene and private setting.​

Spacious, sophisticated, and exquisitely detailed, the Presidential Suite delivers a top-tier stay in every sense. With a grand living room, a private dining area, and a marble bathroom overlooking the city with a deep soaking tub, every corner is designed for seamless comfort and refined living. Whether you're unwinding in quiet solitude or hosting meaningful gatherings, this is where you’ll feel completely at ease—just like home, only elevated.​

dining_services.description: Set in a simple yet beautifully appointed dining room and replete with the cuisine’s valued cultural rituals, this dining destination is inspired by the first truly authentic Italian lifestyle and aligned with the city’s refined taste and discernment. Simple modern techniques meet bombastic Italian flavors to reveal a must-visit gourmet dining experience for the whole family.

Ember Kitchen is your go-to spot for all-day dining, offering tasty pan-Asian dishes alongside Western favorites. With a cozy atmosphere that transitions from a breakfast buffet to a delightful lunch and dinner menu, you can choose between indoor or outdoor seating. Our friendly culinary team ensures a special experience, whether you're enjoying a hearty breakfast, a casual business lunch, or a warm dinner with family and friends.

Star 32 rises above the city with panoramic views, ambient energy, and a design that flows seamlessly from day to night. More than a rooftop bar, it’s a dynamic space for social gatherings, private events, or stylish soirées. Indoors or out, every corner invites connection – set against a skyline that makes every moment feel unforgettable.

Oi Living is the social heart of Vinpearl Hotel Bac Ninh - a stylish, open-concept lobby lounge where guests can meet, relax, or refuel throughout the day. It’s a versatile space that transitions effortlessly from morning coffee to afternoon high tea and evening cocktails.

Pearl Club is the executive lounge, offering a cozy residential space ideal for working, relaxing, or unwinding. Guests can enjoy complimentary food and beverages featuring local and international flavors throughout the day, with a bartender mixing up delicious cocktails during Happy Hour. With various seating zones designed for comfort and flexibility, Pearl Club is the perfect escape to recharge after a busy day.
